nom: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% for Wrinkles and Skin Elasticity

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are divided: some report a burning, stinging reaction with breakouts within the first days, while others, including one with very oily, sensitive, breakout-prone skin, report no reaction and smaller, less noticeable pores over time.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the serum resolved bumpy texture and flaky patches and plumped the skin, though one in a dry climate warns the hyaluronic acid in the formula can pull moisture away from skin rather than hydrate it.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report smoother, clearer skin and a marked reduction in wrinkles, but one who also describes her skin as sensitive, reactive, and acne-prone had to wash the serum off after itching, redness, burning, and irritation on the second use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report stinging, new breakouts, or an itching and redness reaction, in one case severe enough to need a steroid cream and antihistamines, within the first two applications, while others with sensitive or sensitive-combination skin report the serum calms their skin with no reaction at all.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature, or who are in their 50s to 70s, consistently report brighter, firmer skin with visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles after weeks to months of regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer with neither oily nor dry skin reports no skin reaction but describes the serum's blue tint sitting on top of the skin and rolling off under the fingers hours after application.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, especially those over 40 using the serum consistently for weeks to months, report visibly reduced fine lines, wrinkles, and crow's feet along with firmer, plumper skin, with some describing further gains over a year or more of use. A minority say they saw no change even after a full month or two bottles and consider it not worth the price.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, reporting plumper, less dry, glowing skin and relief from flaky or bumpy texture with regular use. One reviewer in a dry climate warns the hyaluronic acid in the formula can pull moisture away from skin rather than add it, and another experienced dryness alongside breakouts on the first night of use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report redness as part of an adverse reaction, including itching, burning, welts, or red patches resembling perioral dermatitis, sometimes appearing after just one or two applications and in one case requiring a steroid cream and antihistamines to resolve. Other reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report the opposite: the serum calms their skin with no reaction at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports needing about six weeks to rebuild her skin barrier after a burning reaction and breakouts, after which she switched to the copper-free version of the same serum; no other reviewers describe comparable barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers credit the serum with fading dark spots, old acne scars, sun damage, and general hyperpigmentation over weeks of use. Others report the opposite: within days the serum caused new-looking discoloration such as an orange or yellow tint, or patches of darkened skin, particularly around the mouth, eyebrows, and hairline.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some who say they normally have clear skin, report new or worsened breakouts, including painful cystic acne, within the first days of use. Others report the opposite: fewer breakouts overall, faster healing of acne marks, or, in one case, an end to recurring adult breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Can pill or leave blue residue if layered wrong
Feels sticky until moisturizer goes on top
Faint copper or vinegar-like scent fades quickly
Absorbs well and layers easily once dry
Much cheaper than premium copper-peptide alternatives
Some bottles arrived without a safety seal

extraits.texte: I really looked forward to using this. I added this to my night time regimen with no other actives. I had some breakouts and dryness the first night. Unfortunately, by my second application (2nd night), I experienced itching, redness, burning, and irritation. It was so uncomfortable, I had to wash it off with a gentle cleanser and use a steroid cream. For reference, my skin is combo, sensitve/reactive, and prone to acne. If you have sensitive skin, reactive skin, eczema prone skin, or rosacea, please patch test and proceed with caution.

I bought this few days back and have used it only 3 times and in mere 3 days it caused me so much hyperpigmentation. Literally my face looks very dark compared to the lower part of my neck where i havent applied it. My skin feels firm but its very dull and pigmented. Not good for me. If anyone else faced the same situation, comment down
The first use of this product stung when applied. The next few days developed a significant amount of acne, even following the recommended use. Waste of money IMO.

extraits.titre: I loved it but my skin didnt
extraits.texte: I bought this in Feb 2024 and used it for about 10 days before my oily, sensitive and acne prone skin reacted to it. I suffered a burning/stinging reaction and had acne breakouts whilst having beautiful glass skin in the process. I stopped the product for 2-3 weeks and restarted it because I really wanted my skin to cooperate but alas the burning sensation restarted again and then I finally gave up. I rebuilt by skin barrier over the next 6 weeks and went back to using the ordinary buffet serum WITHOUT copper which my skin is not allergic to.

This is my third order for this product. I think what many people don't understand is that you won't see immediate results with any of these products but you will over over time. I have used this product as part,of my regimen for over a year and I can see a noticeable difference in deep wrinkles and the slight ones are gone. I am over 60 yrs old and have previously taken great care with my skin. Peptides are great for skin and combined with copper peptides—over time, expect a mini miracle. I wish it was formulated for Seniors like me containing even more good stuff! I give this product 10 stars and the wish for users that they use it twice a day for over 130 days to see results. The results will speak to you!

I am currently into skincare and I am so glad I visited Ulta on the day they had a rep from The Ordinary in the store I frequent. The Ordinary offers so many different products however it's important to know what each product does and how it interacts with other products before purchasing. I finally got the answers I needed from an actual rep. This product was recommended for my mature skin along with the hyaluronic B5 which I purchased. Just for reference: mature skin, very oily, sensitive, prone to breakouts. I am on day four of applying this (night routine) after my hyaluronic (first step cleanse, hyaluronic, copper peptides, eye cream)….and I am liking what I am seeing so far. I also alternate every other night with a retinol because she informed me to not use both at the same time….therefore, I alternate). What I am noticing is that my skin is having no reaction to this 👏🏻 other than feeling very moisturized, plump, and dewy and we will see down the road how it handles my faint forehead lines and parenthesis.

extraits.titre: The Superstar of my skin care routine
extraits.texte: I got gifted and outrageously expensive moisturizer and was really upset when my skin loved it. I looked at the active ingredients and compared them to products I was using and copper peptides were the only one that was new. Luckily I found this product and achieved the same results at a fraction of the price. I have now been using this product for a few years and it's truly my holy grail. I have really dry skin and USED TO struggle with bumpy texture and flakey areas, but this cleared that up. I'm not a super regimented skin care user and can forget from time to time and even so flakes don't immediately return and it takes weeks of being out to see bumps popping back up. I use it in my morning routine because it makes my skin look plumper and me less tired immediately.
